texts.secretariat_outline: Every one has the right to a fair share of rest and leisure.
texts.cassin_draft: Every one has the right to a fair share of rest and leisure and to the knowledge of the outside world.

texts.e_cn4_57: Everyone has the right to rest and leisure."
texts.geneva_draft: 1. Every one has the right to rest and leisure. 2. Rest and leisure should be ensured to every one by laws or contracts providing in particular for reasonable limitations on working hours and for periodic vacations with pay.

texts.a777: Everyone has the right to rest and leisure, including reasonable limitation of working hours and periodic holidays with pay.
texts.final: Everyone has the right to rest and leisure, including reasonable limitation of working hours and periodic holidays with pay.
